full_judgment:
AKM Fazlur Rahman J: This is a reference under section 374 of the Code of Criminal Procedure submitted by the learned Judge of Druta Bichar Tribunal No.3, Dhaka for confirmation of sentence of death awarded by him to absconding accused Al Hasib Bin Jamal alias Hasib, Almas and Anif Mahmud alias Aurango @ Anga and condemned-prisoners Md Khaja, Md Sohrab alias Sohrab and Abu Taher alias Taha convicting them under sections 302/120B/34 of the Penal Code in Druta Bichar Tribunal Case No. 22 of 2003 arising out of Rupganj Police Station Case No. 20(8)2000 by the judgment and order dated 18-1-2004. Those convicts were also sentenced to pay a fine of Taka 10,000 each. Challenging the legality and propriety of that judgment and order of conviction and sentence, condemned prisoner Abu Taher alias Taha preferred Criminal Appeal No. 154 of 2004 and condemned-prisoners Md Khaja and Sohrab alias Sohrab preferred Criminal Appeal No.163 of 2004. These three condemned-prisoners also filed Jail Appeal No. 145 of 2004. The reference and both the criminal appeals and jail appeal having arisen out of the same judgment and order, have been heard together and are being disposed of by this judgment. 

 2. The prosecution case, in brief, is that on 26-8-2000 at 3-30 PM while deceased Rasel Bhuiyan was gossiping with Sharif and Swapan sitting on a bench to the western side of the southem bank of the tank in his own park named Rasel Park, accused Almas, Aurango alias Anga, Taher alias Taha, Khaja and Sohrab entered into the park and came in front of the deceased. Accused Almas shot to the chest of the deceased with a firearm causing bleeding injury. Accused Aurango shot to his right abdomen causing another grievous injury. The deceased ran towards east to escape. At that moment Taha, Khaja and Sohrab shot him at random causing 5/6 bullet injuries on his hands and legs. The deceased's elder brother Azahar Ali Bhuiyan, sister's husband Altaf Hossain, Driver Monir, Sharif and Swap an saw the occurrence. The accused persons threatened them with death pointing firearms when they went forward to rescue the deceased. At the time of leaving the park when Jashim took an attempt to catch hold of the accused persons they threatened him touching a pistol to his chest. Thereafter, the accused persons fled away boarding on a baby taxi awaiting on the gate of the park. Azahar Ali Bhuiyan, Altaf Hossain, Rabiul and Sharif shifted the deceased in critical condition to Dhaka Medical College Hospital by a microbus. Informant Zakia Bhuiyan, the wife of the deceased, who was in the residence of the deceased at Purana Pal tan, Dhaka, having been informed by Azahar Ali Bhuiyan over telephone, rushed to Dhaka Medical College Hospital where her husband was admitted. After surgical operation he was kept in the intensive care unit of the hospital. 

 4. Md Nabi Hossain, the Officer-in-Charge of Rupganj Police Station, while was on duty at Murapara ferry ghat received the information of tiring on the deceased in the park. He at once rushed to the place of occurrence park and found that the deceased had already been taken away to Dhaka Medical College Hospital. He heard the occurrence, searched for the assailants, seized a percussion cap of revolver having mark of pin as alamat from the place of occurrence under a seizure list and prepared a sketch map of the place of occurrence with an index. Then he went, to Dhaka Medical College Hospital, saw injured Rasel Bhuiyan, met with Azahar Ali Bhuiyan, the elder brother of the deceased and other relatives of the deceased and asked them to lodge first information report who replied that they would lodge the same later on. He stayed in the hospital for an hour and then returning to the police station at 11-55 PM recorded GD Entry No. 942 dated 26-8-2000 about the occurrence, 

 6. During investigation of the case confessional statements of accused Monir and Zahid Hassan @ Aslam were recorded by the Magistrates under section 164 of the Code of Criminal Procedure. Police after investigation submitted charge sheet against nine accused persons, namely AI Hasib Bin lamal alias Hasib, Almas Anif Mahmud @ Aurango @ Anga, Md Khaja, Sohrab, Abu Taher @ Taha, Zahid Hassan @ Aslam, Monir Hossain and Main Uddin Bhuiyan @ Main, of whom accused Almas was absconding all through. At first they were put to trial in the Court of Additional Sessions Judge, 1st Court, Narayanganj, wherein charge under sections 302/34 of the Penal Code against accused Abu Taher @ Taha, Md Khaja, Sohrab @ Sorhab Monir Hossain, Zahid Hassan @ Aslam, Anif Mahmud @ Aurango @ Anga and Almas (absconding) and under sections 302/109 of the same Code against AI Hasib Bin Jamal @ Hasib and Main Uddin Bhuiyan @ Main was framed. The accused persons on dock pleaded innocence and demanded justice. Thereafter, the case was transferred to the Druta Bichar Tribunal No.3, Dhaka, wherein additional charge under section 120B of the Penal Code was framed against all the accused persons, to which the accused persons on dock pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried. 

 10. PW 1 lakia Bhuiyan is the informant and wife of deceased Rasel Bhuiyan. She stated in the Court that on 26-8-2000 at 3-00 PM while her husband Rasel Bhuiyan was chatting with Sharif and Swapan sitting on a bench to the west side of the southern bank of the pond inside Rasel Park, accused Almas, Aurango @ Anga, Taher @ Taha, Khaja and Sohrab entered into the park. In order to kill her husband at first accuseds Almas shot him with a firearm causing grievous injury on his chest. Then accused Anga shot him causing injury on the right side of his abdomen. To escape he ran towards east and took shelter on the west side slope of the tank, when accused Taha, Khaja and Sohrab shot him at random causing 5/6 injuries on his hands and legs. The accused persons threatened her husband's. elder brother Azahar Ali Bhuiyan (PW 8), her sister-in-law's husband Altar Hossain (PW 20), Driver Monir (PW 3), Sharif (PW 2) and Swapan (not examined) when they went forward to resist them. They also threatened Jashim pointing a pistol at his chest when he tried to grab them. Azahar Ali Bhuiyan, Altaf Hossain, Rabiul and Sharif removed her husband in critical condition to Dhaka Medical College Hospital, wherein his surgical operation was done and then he was kept in the intensive care unit. She further stated that after surgical operation the doctor handed over to her the wearing apparels of her husband. At the time of occurrence she was in her residence at Purana Pal tan, Dhaka. At about 3-45 PM her husband's elder brother Azahar Ali Bhuiyan informed her of the occurrence. over telephone. Then she rushed to Dhaka Medical College Hospital. After her arrival there, her husband was brought at the gate of the Medical College Hospital by a vehicle. She saw bullet injuries on his person. She also stated that some days before the occurrence, accused Hasib, Aurango @ Anga, Almas, Aslam, Main, Khaja, Sohrab and Taha made conspiracy to kill her husband in the office of accused Hasib in the 3rd floor of Bhuiyan Mansion at Motijheel, Dhaka. Accordingly, the accused persons killed him. Some time before the occurrence accused Hasib, Anga, Almas, Taha, Khaja and Sohrab made conspiracy in the sweater factory of accused Hasib at Rupganj Upazila headquarters. Then coming to the gate of the sweater factory accused Hasib ordered other accused persons to go and return after killing her husband. She further stated that as her husband used to protest the terrorist activities of Hasib, Anga and their associates, the accused persons conspired to finish him. Moreover, there was dispute between her husband and accused Hasib over a tank situated contiguous to the' house of Hasib. After lodging of first information report she heard about such plan and conspiracy from her brother-in-law Moniruzzaman Bhuiyan and Golam Faruque. She also stated that she lodged first information report knowing details of the occurrence from Azahar Ali Bhuiyan, Altaf Hossain and Monir Driver. She sent the ejahar to the police station through Azahar Ali Bhuiyan. She identified the ejahar and her signature therein. The ejahar was marked as Exhibit 1 and her signatures therein were marked as Exhibits 1/1 and 1/2. She identified accused Main, Tahar, Aslam, Aurango, Khaja and Sohrab on the dock. She also stated that her husband died in the morning of 29-8-2000 in Dhaka Medical C911ege Hospital, where he was under treatment. In cross-examination, she stated that their dwelling house was within the area of the park, which covered 30/35 acres of land. The entry fee in the park was Taka 10 per head. There was a guard on the gate. On the date of occurrence Khair (PW 13) was on duty on the gate as a guard. Their dwelling house was 50/60 yards distance from the pond. There was a canteen and a rest house 20/25 cubits away from the bank of the pond. She used to live in Dhaka and occasionally used to visit Rupganj. Presence of the visitors in the park at 3-00/3-30 PM was thin. There were 10/15 employees in the park. She could not give the number of employees of the canteen. Her husband established the park 13 years ago. There were some houses beside the gate of the park towards upazila headquarter, But she could not give the names of the inhabitants of those houses. The Post Office and T &T buildings were situated beside those houses. Her husband had a revolver with him at the time of occurrence, which was missing since the occurrence. She heard that accused Aurango was a contractor. He became the Chairman of BRDB Association showing threat. She did not know from where Azahar Ali Bhuiyan got the ejahar typed. She stated that it was not mentioned in the ejahar that some days before the occurrence in the office of accused Hasib in the 3rd floor of Bhuiyan Mansion, at Motijheel the accuseq persons made conspiracy to kill her husband, and she came to know that fact after lodging of the ejahar. Before the occurrence neither she nor her husband made any GD entry. The park was established on the land of her father-in-law and the land purchased by her husband. Her brothers-in-law had share in the park. She denied the suggestion that there was strained relationship between her husband and his brothers as the park was named Rasel Park. She heard that the officer-in-charge of Rupganj Police Station had come to Dhaka Medical College Hospital in the evening of the date of occurrence. But she had no talk with him. Her brother-in-law did not take her to the officer-in-charge. She did not know whether her brothers-in-law lodged any ejahar to the Officer- in-charge. She denied the suggestion that she did not know about the occurrence and for that she did not lodge ejahar to the Officer-in-charge in the hospital or the case was concocted afterwards falsely implicating the accused persons. She also denied the suggestion that at the time of occurrence accused Aurango was in the Officers Club of Rupganj Upazila with the officers. She further said, that she did not .know that the Officer-in-charge of Rupganj Police Station going to the place of occurrence did not get support of the manner of the occurrence as alleged. Delay in lodging first information report was due to treatment of her husband. She was examined by the investigation officer on 28-8,-2000, is presence of her brother-in-law; Moniruzzaman Bhuiyan. She stayed beside the bed of her husband in the hospital till his death. She, occasionally, would go to the residence. Her relatives, elder brother-in-law and younger brother-in-law Moniruzzaman would visit the hospital. On the night of 28- 8-2000 she went to the residence from the hospital. Azahar Ali Bhuiyan, Moniruzzaman, Khokan and other relatives were in the hospital. Her husband used to visit Rupganj each week and mostly on holidays. She further said that the ejahar was written. in her residence at 55/1 Purana Paltan, Dhaka. At that time Azahar Ali Bhuiyan, Altaf Hossain and Driver Monir were present. Her elder brother-in-law Azhar Ali Bhuiyan read over the ejahar after it was computer printed. Accused Khaja and Sohrab were, not named in the ejahar. Their names were known subsequently. The men from whom 'she heard of the occurrence did not tell the names of those two accused before lodging the ejahar. She denied the defence suggestion that her husband had dispute with his brothers over their paternal property or that accused Khaja and Sohrab were falsely implicated out of political rivalry. Accused Almas was not known to her before the occurrence. There was no brick-made boundary wall in the park. Ticket was required for entrance in the park. She did not know whether Azahar Ali Bhuiyan and AltafHossain were Awami League activists, Before lodging ejahar she had talk with her brother-in-law. She heard the occurrence in detail on 27-8-2000 at 8-00/9-00 PM from Azahar Ali Bhuiyan and Altaf Hossain. She also heard that the Officer-in-charge of the police station came to the hospital on 27-8-2000. At that time she did not meet with him. She did not advise Azahar Ali Bhuiyan and Altaf Hossain to lodge ejahar to the Officer-in-charge giving details of the occurrence. She denied the suggestion that she heard that three unidentified terrorists at the behest of her brother-in-law Azahar Ali Bhuiyan shot her husband or at the advice of her brother-in-law Azahar Ali Bhuiyan she lodged the first information report falsely implicating the accused persons. She signed the ejaharin presence of 4/5 persons including Azahar Ali Bhuiyan and Altaf Hossain in her residence at 5-30 or 6-00 PM. At about 7-00/8-00 PM Azahar Ali Bhuiyan left her residence. There was no paper for showing that her husband had enmity with accused Hasib. She also stated that they were possessing the tank as the lessee under the Government. They had no dispute over the tank with accused Hasib. One Meser Ali was arrested in connection with this case. She denied the suggestion that when Meser Ali was on bail her brother- in-law and witness Rabiul (PW 6) assaulted him to death. She admitted in her cross-examination that on the date of occurrence accused Hasib did not go to Rupganj, 

 11. PW 2 Md Sharif Mia deposed that on 26-8-2000 at 3-30 PM he was sitting with the deceased and a visitor named Swapanon a brick-made bench to the west side of the southern bank of the big tank at Rasel Park. At that time accused Almas, Aurango, Khaja, Taher and Sohrab entered into the park and came in front of them. Accused Almas shot at the chest of the deceased and then Aurango shot at the abdomen. The deceased ran towards south to escape, when accused Taher, Khaja and Sohrab shot at him at random. The deceased fell down. The accused persons perceiving him dead went out of the park through the northern gate and fled away boarding on a babytaxi He further said that he and others took away the deceased in critical condition to Dhaka Medical College Hospital by a vehicle. Some time after her return to the park in search of some important papers he left there. At that time the police arrived in the park, seized percussion cap of cartridge from the place of occurrence preparing a seizure list. He signed the seizure list. He identified his signature in the seizure list. The seizure list was marked as Exhibit. 2 and his signature therein was marked as Exhibit 2/1. He further said that on 28- 8-2000 the Daroga seized blood-stained wearring safari shirt, a trousers, a handkerchief and a pair of stockings of the deceased preparing a seizure list, wherein he put his signature. He identified his signature in the seizure list. The seizure list was marked as Exhibit 3 and his signature in the seizure list was marked as Exhibit 3/1. He further said that on 29-8-2000 the deceased died in the hospital. He identified accused Aurango, Khaja, Taher, Sohrab on dock: In cross-examination, he stated that he could not say the number of the baby-taxi of the accused persons of which accused Monir was the driver. Rabiul Sikder, Bakul and others said that Monir drove the baby taxi. This witness on recall identified in the Court the seized wearing apparels of the deceased, which were marked as Material Exhibits I, II, Ill, IV and lV/1. On his showing the seized percussion cap of bullet was marked as Material Exhibit V. He further stated in his cross- examination that he was of village Dariakandi, which was half a mile distance from the place of occurrence park. He was a mechanic of Gousia Jute Mills. The mill would run 24 hours, except Friday. The house of accused Aurango was 50/60 yards distance from the place of occurrence park. A brother of Aurango was a doctor. They had a dwelling building. There was a guard on duty at the gate of the park. He was acquainted with the deceased for about 15/16 years. The bench in which he was sitting was east to west in length. He sat at the east end of the bench, the deceased sat at the west end, while Swapan was in the middle, The accused persons were at a distance of three cubits from the deceased. They shot the deceased from that place. He saw the occurrence of shooting from 2/3 feet distance. At the time of occurrence he raised no alarm as threatened by the accused. He also raised no voice to grab the accused at the time of their departure by baby taxi. The deceased fell down in a place 15/20 cubits away from the bench, where they were sitting. Blood oozed on receipt of first bullet injury. They carried the deceased outside the park. He stayed in the park about 15/20 minutes after the occurrence. The deceased had a car with a driver, but the deceased was not shifted to Dhaka Medical College Hospital by that car. The vehicle by which the deceased was shifted to the hospital was not driven by his driver. At about 4-45 PM they arrived at Dhaka Medical College Hospital, where he stayed for 15/16 minutes only. He returned to Murapara at 6-00 PM. He did not disclose the occurrence to anybody on way of returning to the park. The park was half kilometrea way from Murapara Bazar. He on returning to the park found police present there. He then said that some time after his returning to the park Nabi Hossain, the Officer-in-Charge of Rupganj Police Station, came to the park. At that time he did not say to him who were the assailants and who in what manner had shot the deceased. He did not lodge written complaint to him. Next day also he did not complain. Returning to the park from the hospital he did not find out his important papers left there. Later on he found out those papers. He pointed out the place of occurrence to the officer-in-charge. No blood was seized therefrom in his presence. On 27-8-2000 and 28-8- 2000 also he went to the hospital. At that time of first two shots the deceased was sitting. No bullet hit him (PW 2). He saw Azahar Bhuiyan, Monir-uz-zaman Bhuiyan and Suman Bhuiyan in the hospital. He denied the suggestion that no occurrence in the manner as he stated took place or that as a family friend of the deceased he was deposing falsely or that at the time of occurrence he was not present in the park and did not witness the occurrence and for that he said nothing about the occurrence to the Officer-in-charge of the police station on the date of occurrence at 6-30 PM. He also stated that he was leading Rupganj Upazila Jatiotabadi Shramik Dal for long. For the first time he met with the investigating officer on 26-8-2000, when he had usual talk with him. On the date of occurrence he met with the informant in the hospital, where he did not disclose the names of accused Khaja and Sohrab to her. He further said that at the time of occurrence Azahar Ali Bhuiyan and Altaf Hossain were sitting in a balcony in the park and driver Monir Hossain was standing to the west side. He had no talk with them on the date of occurrence. They also went to Dhaka Medical College Hospital. He did not shift the deceased to the hospital with Azahar Ali Bhuiyan and AltafHossain by the same vehicle. He had no talk with Azahar Ali Bhuiyan, Altaf Hossain and Monir Driver in the hospital. 

 12. PW 3 Monir Hossain deposed that he was the driver of the car of the deceased for seven years. On 26-8-2000 at 3-00/3-30 PM the occurrence took place. At that time the deceased, visitors Swapan and Sharif sitting on a bench to the west side of the southern bank of the big pond were talking. He was roaming at the western bank of the pond. Suddenly he saw accused Almas, Aurango @ Anga, Khaja, Taha and Sohrab near the deceased. Accused Almas shot at the chest of the deceased and Aurango shot at the abdomen. The deceased ran to the southern slope of the bank of the pond to escape, when accused Taha, Khaja and Sohrab shot him indiscriminately. The deceased fell down being hit by bullets. The accused persons perceiving him dead fled away through the northern gate by a scooter. Brother of the deceased was sitting on a balcony to the southern bank of the pond. Immediately after the occurrence Azahar Bhuiyan, Altaf  Hossain and Sharif carried the deceased out of the park. Rabiul Sikder came forward. They took away the deceased to Dhaka Medical College Hospital by a microbus of the visitors. Three days after the deceased died in the hospital. This witness identified accused Auran go, Khaja, Taha and Sohrab on dock. In cross-examination he stated that he hailed from Bikrampur. On the date of occurrence at 9-00 AM he drove the car of the deceased to Rupganj with the deceased, his elder brother Azahar Bhuiyan and sister's husband Altaf Hossain. He could not say whether police came to the place of occurrence after the occurrence. None took him to the police station or advised him to go to the police station and to state what he witnessed. After the occurrence he continued to serve as the driver of the family of the deceased. Two months after the occurrence when Officer-in-charge of Rupganj Police Station came to the park he talked with him and at that time he was examined. He denied the suggestion that at the time of occurrence he was not present in the park and did not witness the occurrence and for that he was not taken to the police station to give statement or that at the behest of the informant and her relatives he was deposing falsely to save his job. He further stated that he did not go to Dhaka Medical College Hospital by the microbus by which the deceased was shifted there. He went there driving the car of the deceased following the microbus. As it was not possible to carry more than four persons in the car, the injured was carried by a microbus. Henarrated the occurrence to the informant before giving statement to the Daroga. On the day of occurrence at about 4-45 PM he met with wife of the deceased at Dhaka Medical College Hospital, but he had no talk with the wife, brother, sister, brother-in-law or other relatives of the deceased in the hospital. He (PW 3) had no close relative at Rupganj, 

 14. PW 5 Imtiaz Hossain stated that deceased Rasel Bhuiyan was his maternal uncle. On 26-8-2000 at 2-10/15-00 PM he left the house of his maternal uncle attached to Rasel Park for the house of his paternal grandfather. For want of a rickshaw he was going on foot. At about 2-30 PM when he was passing beside the factory of accused Hasib he saw accused Hasib, Anga, Almas, Khaja, Sohrab, Main standing on the gate of the factory. He heard Hasib to say that due to interference of Rasel Bhuiyan he could not.do any work, A baby taxi with a driver was standing there. There was a motorcycle inside the gate. Those accused persons became silent sensing his presence. Thereafter, he went to his paternal grandfather's house. At about 4-30 PM the domestic help of that house informed him that his maternal uncle had been shot. He at once rushed to his maternal uncle's house by a rickshaw and came to know from the domestic help of that house that Aurango and five others had shot the deceased, who had already been shifted to Dhaka. Then he rushed to Dhaka Medical College Hospital. At that time preparation for operation of the deceased was going on. He further said that the deceased died in the hospital on 29-8-2000. In cross-examination, he stated that from 6-00/6-15 of 26-8-2000 to the evening of 28-8-2000 he stayed in the hospital. He did not know whether on that date police of Rupganj Police Station had come to the hospital. His all maternal uncles were present in the hospital. Advocate Badiuzzaman was one of his maternal uncles. He (PW 5) did not advise his maternal uncles to inform the occurrence to the police station. He had no talk with the police till the death of his maternal uncle on 29-8-2000. After the death of his maternal uncle police came, but he had no talk with them as he was busy with the nursing of his maternal uncle. On 29-8-2000 in the afternoon he went to the village home of his maternal uncle with the dead body. The police was present at the time of burial of the dead body. He met with the police officer, but did not say what he had witnessed. Police officer attended in the 'Qulkhwani' ceremony of the deceased. He talked with the police on 3-10-2000. He denied the suggestion that he did not see accused Anga, Hasib, Khaja, Almas, Sohrab and Main in front of the factory of Hasib and did not hear Hasib to say the name of the deceased. He further said that after the occurrence his father Altaf Hossain (PW 20) took away the deceased to the hospital. Be did not talk about the occurrence in the hospital. At the time of occurrence he used to serve in Sonali Bank, Banga Bandhu Avenue Branch. Next day of occurrence at 12-00/1-00 PM he had talk with the informant. On the date of occurrence they all met with the informant. He stated to her the details next day of occurrence. But at that time he did not say the names of the accused Khaja and Sohrab. His bank hours were from 9-00 AM to 4-00 PM. They used to live in a rented house at Purana Paltan. 

 15. PW 6 Rabiul Sikderdeposed that he Was a contractor and he had rice business at Murapara. On the date of occurrence at 3-30 PM he was standing on the bank of a tank beside their house. At the time some people were running towards Upazila headquarters from the side of Rasel Park. On his query they said, to him that a man was shot in Rasel Park. Then he started for Rasel Park. When he reached the eastern bank of the pond situated south of Mahmudabad Primary School he sawababytaxi running away at high speed. Five persons, namely accused Almas, Taha, Khaja, Sohrab and Anga boarded on the baby taxi. Accused Monir was the driver. On his arrival in front of Rasel Park he saw some people taking Rasel Bhuiyan to a microbus, who had bullet injuries in different parts of his body. Then he joined with them in shifting Rasel Bhuiyan to Dhaka Medical College Hospital by a microbus. Azahar Ali Bhuiyan, Altaf Hossain and Sharif also went to Dhaka Medical College by the same microbus. Bhuiyan died on 29-8-2000, when he was under treatment in the hospital. He identified accused Khaja, Sohrab, Taha, Aurango on the dock and said that accused Monir and Almas were absent. In cross-examination he admitted that the Daroga examined him 4/5 months after the occurrence. He could not remember whether he stated the name of baby taxi driver Monir to the Daroga. He denied the suggestion that on the date of occurrence he did not see any baby taxi. He admitted that accused Aurango was the Chairman of Rupganj Thana Samabay Samity. He admitted that he deposed against accused Hasib and another in a case of Rupganj Police Station. He also admitted that he was an accused of Miser Ali murder case. On the date of occurrence he stayed in Dhaka Medical College Hospital for 2/3 hours. On receipt of a notice he went-to the police station on 23-1-2001 and gave statement. 

 17. PW 8 Azahar Ali Bhuiyan stated that the informant was the wife of his younger brother Rasel Bhuiyan. On 26-8-2000 around 3-30 PM he and his sister's husband Altaf Hossain were chatting sitting on a balcony to the southern bank of the tank of Rasel Park. Rasel Bhuiyan was chatting with Sharif (PW 2) and a visitor named Swapan, sitting on a brick-made bench at a little distance to the west of them. Suddenly he saw accused Almas, Anga. Taha and unknown two others, whose names subsequently he could know as Sohrab and Khaja, came near Rasel Bhuiyan. Almas shot at the chest of Rasel Bhuiyan and Anga shot at his abdomen, Both of them shot with firearms. Rasel Bhuiyan tried to escape running to the southern slope of the bank of the tank, when accused Sohrab, Khaja and Taha shot him indiscriminately by firearms. Rasel Bhuiyan fell down receiving bullet injuries on his legs. The accused persons went out of the park through the northern gate and fled away boarding on the baby taxi waiting at the gate. He (PW 8) and Altaf Hossain were threatened to be shot when they tried to resist the accused. He, Sharif and Altaf Hossain carried Rasel Bhuiyan to a vehicle and took him to Dhaka Medical College Hospital, where he was admitted. The doctor operated him: Thereafter he was kept in the intensive care unit. He died in the morning of 29-8-2000. This witness further said that subsequently he came to know that in the 3rd floor of Bhuiyan Mansion at Motijheel, Dhaka, accused Haslb, Main, Aslam, Almas, Anga, Sohrab, Khaja and Taha made conspiracy to kill Rasel Bhuiyan and accused Almas was paid for the purpose. According to that conspiracy and plan, the occurrence took place. He further came to know that. some time before the occurrence accused Hasib and Main were waiting in the industry of Hasib, where Almas and Taha riding on a motorcycle and Sohrab, Khaja and Anga on a baby taxi came there and made conspiracy. Hasib coming to the gate of the industry ordered to murder the deceased. Accordingly, he was killed. Later on he also came to know that after the occurrence accused Sohrab, Khaja, Anga, Almas and Taha went to the industry of Hasib by a baby- taxi, wherefrom Almas and Taha riding motorcycle and accused Sohrab, Anga and Khaja by the baby taxi went away. He further came to know that Almas led the drive of shooting the deceased. He added that on 29-8-2000 at 11-00 AM the Daroga made inquest of the dead body of the deceased as identified by him and prepared the inquest report, wherein he put his signature. He proved the inquest report I Exhibit 4 and his signature therein, Exhibit 4/1. In cross-examination, he stated that the inquest report was not written in his presence and the same was not read over to him. At that time he was in no mental position to read the same. He did not know what was written in the inquest report. He did not complain to any authority against what was written in the inquest report. Rasel Bhuiyan used to live in Dhaka. He was not the sole owner of the park. Some land of the park was purchased by him. There was no dispute amongst themselves as the deceased alone used to enjoy the park established on their paternal property. He wrote the ejahar at, the dictation of the wife of the deceased at 4-00/5-00 PM sitting in the residence of the deceased at Purana Paltan, Dhaka. PW 3 said that at the time of occurrence he was roaming on the western back of the tank and witnessed five accused persons, namely Almas, Aurango, Khaja, Taha and Sohrab, to fire at the deceased, who was sitting on the bench on the southern bank of the tank. But he disclosed such facts to none. He was examined by the investigating officer on 29-10-2000, that is, more than two months after the occurrence. There is no ground of such belated examination. He was always available. He continued with the service as a driver under PW 1 as before. Unexplained delay in recording his statement under section 161 of the Code of Criminal Procedure gave him chance of falsely implicating the accused persons. Moreover, he hailed from Bikrampur and he used to live in Dhaka. Accused Almas, Aurango, Taha, Khaja and Sohrab are men of Rupganj. He is not supposed to know them. So, his recognition of these five accused persons is not free from doubt. 

 62. PW 8, the star witness of the prosecution, as found above, did not disclose about the fact of re- cognition of the accused persons to the investigating officer when he had talk with him in the hospital. It makes his evidence unreliable. He was a bank officer. His bank was in Dhaka, where he lived with his family. There is no evidence that on the date of occurrence his bank was closed. On the date of occurrence he has no business to go to the park. 

 63. PW 20 was also an officer of a private bank at Dhaka. He used to live in Dhaka with his family. He said that on the date of occurrence there was no function in his father-in-Iaw's house i.e. the house of the deceased in the park. He further said that he went there with the deceased and PW 8 by the car of the deceased. They started from Dhaka at 9-00 AM and arrived in the Park at 10-15 AM. After 10/15 minutes he started for Dhaka and arrived in his bank at 11-00/11-15 AM, where he worked till 1-00 PM and then again started for the park and reached there at 2-00 PM. He admitted that his banking hours was upto 5-00 PM. It is highly improbable story that for 10/15 minutes only he went to the park for nothing. He had no business to go to park on that day. Thus his presence at place of occurrence at the material time is not free from doubt. His statement under section 161 of the Code of Criminal Procedure was recorded by the investigating officer on 1-9-2000, that is, five days after the occurrence. Before that he did not disclose the fact of his witnessing the occurrence and recognition of the accused to anybody. In cross-examination, he made confusing statement. At first he said that he had no talk with PW 8 before the occurrence. At the same breath he said that he and PW 8 were chatting for half an hour. When they were so chatting suddenly hearing sound of two gunshots they at once stood up. His such statement is inconsistent with his evidence that he saw five accused persons with firearms to come in front of the deceased and then he saw accused Almas to shoot at the chest of the deceased and then accused Anga to shoot at his abdomen. 

 72. In the result, the reference is rejected. Criminal Appeal Nos. 154 and 163 of 2004 and Jail Appeal No. 145 of2004 are allowed.
